title: Keep the intrinsic structural promise when a passive circuit can hide a notch between readings
statement: An extra passive parallelRLC in series has Z_n(s)=1/(1/R_n+1/(sL_n)+sC_n). With C_n=1/(omega0^2*L_n), L_n->0 andR_n->infinity, it tends to0 at every fixed sampled frequency!=omega0 but diverges atomega0. The source transfer can match all finite node readings while tending to0 at an unsampled notch.
